description: This file is a C++ header defining interfaces related to protobuf representation in the header checker tool. It declares classes and factory functions for creating dumpers and readers related to protobuf IR (Intermediate Representation).

classes.name: IRDiffDumper
classes.description: Abstract class for dumping IR differences related to protobuf.

classes.name: IRDumper
classes.description: Abstract class for dumping protobuf IR.

classes.name: IRReader
classes.description: Abstract class for reading protobuf IR.

methods.name: CreateProtobufIRDumper
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to an IRDiffDumper, given a dump path.

methods.name: CreateProtobufIRReader
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to an IRReader, given a set of exported headers.

methods.name: CreateProtobufIRDiffDumper
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to an IRDiffDumper, given a dump path.
